release_notes:
Scheduled macros and cleanups now run at the time you set.

Anything set to run at a specific time - a macro, a scheduled clean, a scheduled organise - could start up to five minutes early. An 8:30 AM macro ran at 8:25, and an 11 PM cleanup could begin at 10:57. They now run at the time you chose, or just after it, never before.

A macro with a start time PC AutoPilot could not read used to save without complaint and then never run, with nothing to tell you why. Those are now refused when you save them, with a message saying what to type instead, and any you already have are marked in your Macro Library so you can spot them.

New trigger: Repeat Every. Run a macro on an interval - every 10 minutes, every 2 hours - instead of at one fixed time each day. The shortest interval is 5 minutes and the longest is 24 hours. The first run happens one interval after you save it, not straight away.

AutoPilot AI now lets you choose how it thinks. The model list reads in plain English - Fast, Balanced, or Smartest - instead of raw model names, and the Test button now tests the one you actually picked. If a model is ever retired, PC AutoPilot moves you to the next best one by itself and says so, rather than leaving the assistant broken until the next update.

Also fixed: the assistant could wrongly tell you that PC AutoPilot has no macro feature. It now knows what the app can do, and its answers no longer show stray asterisks and formatting marks. The Dashboard's Upcoming Schedule updates the moment you save or delete a macro instead of waiting for a restart, and the prompts for Wait, Click and Type Text are now proper PC AutoPilot dialogs rather than small system pop-ups.
